purpose: Teach: マヤ/デビッド/アンドリュー/トマス/ザック/ゲール/キティ/マンセー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマヤ文明の遺跡ドキュメンタリー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a documentary about Maya ruins right now.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gently noticing what's happening in the other room. Soft voice, conversational pace. A light smile in the tone—she knows Sho will have his own story to match.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとデビッド・ボウイのライブDVD観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a David Bowie live concert DVD with Dad!
lines.style: Bright and immediate. Quick intake of breath at the start—he's eager to share before she finishes her thought. Genuine pride in the memory. Speaks as if reporting something important he's been holding.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアンドリュー王子のニュースを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching the news about Prince Andrew at the moment.
lines.style: Slightly more measured than before. Still warm but gently noting the shift. Quiet acknowledgment that adults have their own pursuits. Expectant pause—she's learned Sho will answer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと機関車トーマス、つまりトマスの動画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a Thomas the Tank Engine video with Dad—I mean, a Thomas video!
lines.style: Jumps in with correction before she can respond. Breathless excitement. Self-corrects with the confidence of someone sharing a beloved fact. Genuine delight colors every word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがザック・スナイダー監督の映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching a film directed by Zack Snyder right now.
lines.style: Same rhythm as the Prince Andrew line. Gentle, observant, slightly knowing. She's settled into this lovely pattern. Warm but matter-of-fact—this is just what evenings are like in this house.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとケルト・ゲール、つまりゲール文化の番組観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a program about Celtic and Gaelic culture with Dad!
lines.style: Pushes slightly further this time—the content is more sophisticated. Still eager and genuine but with a hint of pride in understanding something new. Says it as though sharing knowledge he's gained.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサンリオのハローキティのグッズを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father gave you Hello Kitty merchandise from Sanrio.
lines.style: Slight shift—this one's different. Warmer, more tender. A small moment of affection noticed and gently named. Quiet delight that he received a gift. Pace is unhurried, warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと韓国の応援「マンセー」の意味を学んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned what the Korean cheer 'Manse' means by watching it with Dad!
lines.style: Final crescendo of pride and joy. Confident and clear. This isn't just watching—he learned something. Speaks with the satisfaction of understanding something cultural and meaningful. Bright, assured close.
